# DeCamillis & Mattingly

> Louisville-based personal injury and wrongful death law firm specializing in high-stakes litigation against Fortune 500 companies.

DeCamillis & Mattingly, PLLC is a Kentucky law firm dedicated to representing clients in wrongful death and personal injury cases. The firm handles complex litigation matters and operates on a contingency fee basis, ensuring clients pay only when they win.
